craft_notes: Sthāyin: nāda-vīra of heard doings resolving to jaya-śānta of conquering close — the treatise ends in blessing (end-prosperity). Waking-even unenjoying (kept paradox: awake yet unenjoying); Maheśvarī-led kept. Rejected: (a) resolving paradox → killed. Read aloud: SO-speech-SPREAD KNOW-ing … WAK-ing EV-en, UN-en-JOY-ing.

lines: So speech-spread knowing this host, gods-over —
l4.sanskrit_cite: iti vāgvyāptividvāṃsam etadvargādhidevatāḥ māheśvarīmukhā devyo jāgare 'pi na bhuñjate
